references.finding: Purple and acid yellow typography balance a chrome sculpture; source marketing title is not reused.
Cream directory with violet ordinals and a narrow chrome-photo edge.
Full-height fashion portrait at left, title and editorial explanation at right.
Two walking models dominate a wide photographic scene with dark editorial type in the quiet margin.
Solid acid yellow statement page with oversized left typography and numbered right detail.
Large violet framework lettering pairs with explicit prose; no SWOT claims or invented data retained.
Large left headline and violet ordinal oppose a vertically sequenced editorial list.
Purple chrome scene reprises the opening identity with a closing action.

limitations: Only supplied raster reference photographs are available; photo areas are clean measured crops rather than original high-resolution files.
